data.notes: David Steckel Compensatory Pick (Unsigned 1st Round Draft Choice)

Due to the shortening of the length of the Entry Draft from 9 rounds to 7 rounds, Los Angeles received a compensatory draft pick in the 7th round of the 2005 Entry Draft for the following trade: Los Angeles trades pick #271 in the 2004 Entry Draft to Columbus for Columbus' 8th round pick in 2005.

Due to the shortening of the length of the Entry Draft from 9 rounds to 7 rounds, Buffalo received a compensatory draft pick in the 7th round of the 2005 Entry Draft for the following trade: San Jose trades Jeff Jillson and their 9th round pick in the 2005 Entry Draft to Buffalo in exchange for Curtis Brown and Andy Delmore.
